visual.general_description: Four-panel color clinical photograph figure of the feet, ankle, lower legs and hands of a dark-skinned person lying on hospital linen, with faint violet-gray or dark spots and patches.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A has two adjacent photographs of the foot, ankle and lower leg with scattered faint violet-gray spots. Panel B shows the backs of both hands on a white blanket with a taped connector at the wrist and no clearly distinguishable lesions. Panel C is a close view of the ankle with several round to oval violet-gray patches. Panel D shows both feet from above with scattered dark spots and patches. Partial lettering on the linen is visible in panels A and D. No charts, arrows, scale bars or printed values are present.

panels.general_description: Two adjacent color photographs under panel letter A showing the foot and ankle region of a dark-skinned person on white linen.
panels.detailed_description: The left photograph shows the top of a foot with the toes pointing upward and the lower leg extending toward the bottom of the frame, on white linen with partial dark lettering. Small faint violet-gray flat spots and tiny dark dots are scattered over the foot, ankle and lower leg, with one slightly larger round pale violet-gray spot beside the ankle. The second photograph, without its own letter, is a closer oblique view of the ankle and heel with several faint purplish-gray patches around the ankle bone and lower leg; toes of the other foot, a green plaid fabric, a watch strap and a hand at the right edge are visible. No arrows, scale bars or measurements are present.
